description: This file defines and exports a plugin entry for the 'Together' provider in the openclaw extension framework. It imports utility functions and configuration, and provides metadata and provider configuration for integration.

methods.name: applyConfig
methods.description: Applies the configuration for the provider using the imported 'applyTogetherConfig' function.

methods.name: buildProvider
methods.description: Builds the provider using the 'buildTogetherProvider' function under 'catalog'.

methods.name: classifyFailoverReason
methods.description: Determines if a failure reason string matches a rate limit condition.
